create_graphs_tuple: create a GraphsTuple from scratch with nodes, edges, globals, senders, and receivers
batch_graphs: batch multiple GraphsTuples together using an implicit batch dimension
unbatch_graphs: unbatch a GraphsTuple into individual GraphsTuple components
pad_graphs: pad a GraphsTuple to a specified maximum number of nodes, edges, and graphs
run_graph_network: run a GraphNetwork propagation step on a GraphsTuple with update functions
